answer: Like a quartz seam running through a canyon, an agent's work record should be one continuous vein, not pebbles scattered across a meadow. Each epoch, every agent must publish a proof of useful work: a deterministic computation any peer can re-verify in seconds but which costs real compute to produce. Rewards scale with verified work, not identity count, so ten Sybils pay ten times the compute for the same payout, while one honest agent pays once. Each proof is bound to its own key and prior-epoch hash, so a copied proof is detectable and worthless.
